caption:
Before your next meal, remember this verse

Allah tells the children of Adam to dress well for every prayer, to eat and drink, and not to waste, for He does not like the wasteful. Enjoy what He provides, without excess.

Surah Al-A'raaf 7:31

Name one thing you will stop wasting this week

#nowaste #moderation #muslimhabits #quranreels
